notes: «فذكر بهذا الإسناد مثله» closes the first route as a back-reference; no previous report is in the packet

«وزاد قال أبو أسامة فحدثني ...» is Abu Usama's addition with its own isnad and a different transmitter: a variant group. «أبو أسامة» is written as the text has it and is not merged with «حماد بن أسامة»
The Khaybar Ashura remark is part of the addition and is in the scene of Abu Musa's report
